text:
Alex: ACME partner asked us to freeze driver/CUDA/ROCm versions for their marketplace image before the joint announcement next Tue. They want a signed compatibility matrix + rollback playbook.
Maria: Clarify: do they require CUDA 12.3 specifically or is 12.2 acceptable?
Alex: They said '12.x certified' but flagged a perf regression on 12.3 in their internal testing. Asking for our recommended pinned combo.
Zheng: We repro'd a p50 latency delta on A100 with CUDA 12.3 + driver 535 on long-context workloads. Short recommendation: CUDA 12.2 + driver 520 is most stable across our infra.
Sam: @Zheng can you paste the minimal repro and observed delta so partners can run it?
Zheng: Snippet: ```bash
# repro loop
python perf_test.py --model gpt-j --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 100
# observed: p50 latency ~+18% on 12.3/535 vs 12.2/520
```
Nina: Compliance asks for a signed PDF matrix and a one-page hotfix playbook that outlines immediate steps if regression hits GA. Can we deliver both by EOD Friday?
Maria: Tight but doable if we split work. I can draft the matrix + partner comms blurb. @Alex can own verification checklist and canary runs.
Alex: I'll kick a canary across staging + Dedicated pools now. @OpsBot kick it off.
OpsBot: Canary job queued: canary-run-5001234567 on pools (staging,dedicated). ETA ~40m. Logs: https://redwood.ci/canaries/5001234567
Sam: I'll draft rollback steps and the pin commands. Proposal: publish stable channel pinned to CUDA 12.2 + driver 520.x, and provide an opt-in experimental 12.3 channel.
Zheng: +1. Add a telemetry guard: if p50 latency increases >10% for 5m, trigger auto-fallback to 12.2/520 image. We can adapt our rollout script.
Maria: Deliverables: (1) compatibility matrix PDF, (2) one-page hotfix playbook, (3) partner-facing comms blurb. Draft by Fri 5pm PT.
Alex: Canary finished: 12.2/520 shows no regression on our staging clusters. 12.3/535 reproduces the perf delta. See logs.
Nina: Partner also wants a nightly smoke plan for the 7 days post-GA. Can we commit to 7-day post-release monitoring?
Sam: Yes. Schedule 30m daily smoke runs + a daily digest. I'll add ops runbook entries and Slack alerts.
Maria: Action items: Maria -> drafts PDFs + blurb (due Fri EOD); Alex -> full verification checklist + canary results (today); Sam -> rollback/runbook + daily smoke schedule (tomorrow); Zheng -> attach repro + telemetry thresholds (today); Nina -> coordinate partner comms and confirm acceptance.
Alex: Assigning owners in the shared doc. Please @mention when you update so I can sign off.
Nina: I'll confirm with ACME that CUDA 12.2 + driver 520.x is acceptable and loop PM/legal for signoff. :thumbsup:
Maria: Include exact image tags we will publish, e.g. `redwood/runtime:cuda12.2-driver520-rc1` so partners can pin them.
Zheng: Add an FAQ entry: "Why not 12.3?" with the perf link and mitigation steps.
Sam: If partner wants a hotfix cadence, propose a 48-72h emergency window for driver hotpatches with partner PMs looped in.
Nina: Thanks all. I'll post partner signoff when received.
Alex: If partner pushes for 12.3 we reconvene; otherwise we ship the signed matrix + playbook.
